extDescription.message: True-black (#000000) dark mode for OLED screens. Readable text, untouched images, per-site controls. Free and open source.

cmdToggleExtension.message: Turn OLED Night on or off everywhere

cmdToggleSite.message: Turn OLED Night on or off for the current site

cmdToggleExtensionBackup.message: Turn OLED Night on or off everywhere (alternate shortcut)

cmdToggleSiteBackup.message: Turn OLED Night on or off for the current site (alternate shortcut)

welcomeLead.message: Every site you open is now true black. Text stays readable and photos keep their colors.

welcomePinBody.message: Click the puzzle-piece icon next to the address bar, then the pin beside OLED Night. Its popup controls the current site.

welcomeModesTitle.message: Choose a mode for any site

modeAutoBody.message: Recolors light sites. On sites that are already dark, it only deepens their grays.

modeRecolorBody.message: Always recolors, even when a site already looks dark.

modeDeepenBody.message: Only pushes the darkest grays to true black.

modeInvertBody.message: For canvas apps such as spreadsheets: flips the page, then flips images back.

shortcutSite.message: On or off for the current site

welcomeReport.message: Something look wrong on a site? Open the popup and choose Report a broken site.
